description: Take a reference ad (a breakdown_id from breakdown_ad, a video link, or pasted ad text) and write 1-3 scene-by-scene UGC script variants for a different product that keep the same hook type and structure without copying the competitor. Returns an open_url that loads the scripts into UGCfy AI, where the user can render them as videos with AI actors.

breakdown_id.description: Reuse a breakdown from breakdown_ad (saves time; valid 7 days).

product.description: Product page URL, or a short description of the product (what it is, who it is for, the main benefit).

reference_transcript.description: Reference ad text, if you have no breakdown_id or video link.

reference_video_url.description: Reference TikTok or Instagram ad URL, if you have no breakdown_id.

variants.description: How many script variants to write (1-3). Default 2.

name: rewrite_ad_for_product
title: Rewrite a proven ad for your product
